claim: Interim/primary 12-month results of the prospective single-arm multicenter SLATE study (Visualase LITT of amygdala and hippocampus for mesial TLE; 21 US sites) reported Engel I in 55.9% (95% lower confidence bound 45.9%) of subjects at 12 months, with qualifying device/procedure/anaesthesia AEs in 7.9% of treated subjects. Source is a conference abstract, not a peer-reviewed full paper.
